apGuide.button: Important: confirm before heading to the center
apGuide.title: AP test centers
apGuide.warningTitle: Important: confirm before heading to the center
apGuide.warningBody: This guide includes centers and schools that have hosted AP exams in previous years. Just because a school is listed does not mean it will host the exams this year.
apGuide.warningAsk: Contact the school directly to confirm:
apGuide.warning1: That it will host AP exams this year.
apGuide.warning2: That it accepts students from other schools.
apGuide.warning3: That it offers the AP subject you want to take.
apGuide.contactTitle: How do you contact the school?
apGuide.contact1: Look up the school's phone number.
apGuide.contact2: Ask to speak with the AP coordinator.
apGuide.contact3: Ask whether the school accepts outside students to take AP exams this year.
apGuide.contact4: Ask about available subjects, registration deadlines, and fees.
apGuide.contactEarly: Start contacting schools as early as possible. Each school may have its own deadlines and policies for accepting students from outside, and seating can be limited.
apGuide.contactLedger: The AP Course Ledger is updated each year in November, so if you cannot find a suitable center, check it again in November.
apGuide.hostingTitle: If the school agrees to host you
apGuide.hostingIntro: The AP coordinator will be responsible for:
apGuide.hosting2: Informing you of the exam date and location.
apGuide.deadline1: The usual deadline for schools to order AP exams is mid-November.
apGuide.deadline2: If you haven't found a center by then, keep searching. A school may be able to add you to its order after the deadline and request a late fee waiver, but that depends on the school's policy.
apGuide.datesCoordinator: The school's AP coordinator will finalize your exam time and location.
apGuide.networkingNote: * The Networking exam is for schools in the 2026–2027 pilot program only.
apGuide.feeUS: United States, its territories, Canada and DoDEA schools
apGuide.lateBody: Applies to exams ordered between November 14 and March 12 for year-long or first-semester courses.
apGuide.cancelBody: Applies when cancelling an exam ordered after the November 13 ordering deadline.
apGuide.discountBody: Students with significant financial need may qualify for a $37 College Board reduction per exam. Additional support may be available depending on the region and school.
apGuide.important1: The school may charge additional proctoring and administration fees.
apGuide.important2: For students testing outside the United States, the College Board base fee is $129, but the final amount may be higher depending on the test center.
